usage: zlscan [-h] [--version] <command> ...

Laser film-scanner simulation. Sub-commands appear in the stage that
implements them; unimplemented ones exit with a non-zero status.

positional arguments:
  <command>
    budget       feasibility budget: geometry, photons, signal levels, data
                 path
    check        rule checks on the hardware profile and configuration
    run          run a simulation and write a run directory
    sweep        parameter sweep over independent runs
    calibrate    estimate a calibration file from calibration scans
    reconstruct  reconstruct an image from a raw stream and a calibration file
    metrics      evaluate image quality against the simulation truth
    ident        import measurements and identify parameters
    compare      compare two runs, simulation against measurement, or two
                 implementations
    report       build an offline report for a run
    cosim        co-simulate the RTL against the digital reference model
    replay       replay a time window from the nearest checkpoint
    serve        start the local query service for the workbench

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --version      show program's version number and exit
